page.overview:
Who is Rance?

Rance was a male Human Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire and an Overseer of the Sith Academy on Korriban during the Cold War. Rance was of average height for a Human and had light skin. He was remembered for his harsh method for training the Sith adepts, sending them to the Korriban wilds, where the students either died or driven mad, and forced to battle to death when they returned to their master.
